change_summary: Keep deterministic file-operation waiting inside one foreground CLI invocation while preserving semantic ownership, terminal readback, and honest deadline continuation.

canonical_skill.note: The Skill selects foreground CLI waiting only when that authenticated transport is already natural, while MCP-only Hosts retain bounded operation polling.

server_contract.note: The collaboration revision advances so installed Hosts can distinguish the new transport-efficiency guidance from the prior compatible contract.

package_manifests.note: Skill and Plugin manifests advance together; compatibility family and minimum revision remain unchanged.

workspace_cli.note: Workspace CLI adds bounded foreground wait flags for file operations; both protected packages advance together to 0.1.0-beta.36.

help_center.note: Public CLI examples show the bounded foreground wait path without changing OAuth, MCP connection, or installation steps.

package_setup.note: SessionStart reports the new Skill release; the full Skill remains the authority for transport choice and completion boundaries.

harness_and_mainline.note: The mainline records why deterministic status waiting belongs below the Host reasoning loop while semantic planning and completion remain Agent-owned.

external_marketplaces.note: First-party publication, public hashes and fresh released-host readback remain release gates; external directory acceptance stays outside repository authority.

release_evidence.note: Trigger, transfer and countercase gates cover one-invocation terminal wait, honest deadline continuation, unchanged immediate reads, Host receipt accounting and synchronized public surfaces.
